label: Connection
description: An approved relationship between this Marfa tenant and an external authority. `kind` discriminates between variants: `app` (an OAuth client this user has authorized) and `integration` (a connected upstream service such as Google Calendar). Lifecycle bounded to active | revoked. Has no tier. The integration kind also carries a `runtime_status` distinct from the lifecycle `status`; runtime_status is server-stamped only (the runtime executor is the legitimate writer).

last_used_at.description: Most recent successful use of any token issued under this grant

revoked_at.description: When the grant was revoked, if any

integration_ref.description: For kind: integration — id of the Integration manifest this connection implements

credential_ref.description: For kind: integration — id of a system.credential item holding the integration's API key

configuration.description: For kind: integration — per-Integration JSON config payload (shape determined by the Integration manifest)

direction.description: For kind: integration — does this integration read from, write to, or both

triggers.description: For kind: integration — array of trigger declarations. Each entry shape: { type: 'schedule' | 'webhook' | 'item-event' | 'manual', ...per-type config }. The Integration manifest constrains which trigger types are valid.

attached_device.description: For kind: integration — id of a system.device item; set when the integration runs on a specific local device (e.g. a sync agent host)

runtime_status.description: For kind: integration — operational health, distinct from the universal lifecycle `status`. Server-stamped only (the runtime executor is the legitimate writer; there is no client write surface).

last_sync_at.description: For kind: integration — last successful sync run timestamp

next_run_at.description: For kind: integration — next scheduled run, when applicable

last_error_at.description: For kind: integration — most recent failure timestamp (cleared on next success)

feed_activity.description: For kind: integration — when true, system.activity items emitted by this integration are server-stamped tier:'feed' (otherwise tier is omitted, as for all other system.* writes)
